rules.why: subject, ticket key, origin match and staging are decided by the script
a refused path list halts the commit

rules.anchor: Exit 2: fix the flags stderr names
rules.why: a usage error is fixed from the script's message

rules.anchor: ask which ticket this belongs to, then rerun with --ticket
rules.why: the script exits 1 on a keyless branch and says how to continue

rules.anchor: stages everything; name each file of this change by explicit path
rules.why: the script exits 3 on add-all flags

rules.anchor: is a glob or pathspec magic; name each file by explicit path
rules.why: the script exits 3 on globs and pathspec magic

rules.anchor: is agent scratch; leave .claude/ and agent notes out of the commit

rules.why: only backticked Applies to origins count as a match; prose falls back to plain

rules.anchor: STOP and ask which ticket this belongs to
rules.why: a required key missing from the branch is asked

rules.anchor: Never guess a key and never fall back to a keyless subject.
rules.why: no invented or omitted ticket key

rules.anchor: Never `git add -A`, `git add .`, or a bare wildcard.

rules.why: .claude/ and agent notes stay out of commits

rules.anchor: If untracked files look ambiguous, list them and ask.
rules.why: ambiguous files are the user's call

rules.anchor: Do not push, do not open a PR, do not amend existing commits unless asked.
rules.why: push and PR belong to commit-push-pr

rules.anchor: Use the convention only when the origin matches **Applies to**
rules.why: a foreign origin gets plain Conventional Commits
